A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same future frame synthesis survey. Their complete text, equations, figures, tables, and references support reliable comparison. Neither contains a separate appendix.

before.justification: Section 2.4 explicitly states that the authors estimate missing dataset statistics using means or medians, reported in Table 1. These constitute original descriptive data-analysis results, although model experiments are attributed to prior work.

after.justification: Section 2.4 and Table 1 retain the authors' estimated dataset statistics. These original descriptive data-analysis outcomes still qualify; the version does not introduce its own model experiments.

M1.justification: Neither version proposes an implemented synthesis algorithm or model. New descriptions of cited methods and prospective hybrid-model or distillation ideas do not establish a change to a proposed procedure.

E1.justification: Table 1 retains the same datasets and represented domains. Added discussion of ViStoryBench and other literature does not document their use in new training, evaluation, or data analysis by this work.

E2.justification: The method inventories in Tables 2–4 are retained and are literature summaries, not evaluated baseline comparisons. Newly cited methods are not experimentally compared by the survey authors.

E3.justification: The dataset-statistic aggregation approach remains unchanged. Discussion of GPT-4o-based evaluation and prospective physical-control scenarios introduces no evaluation protocol actually used by this work.

E4.justification: Neither version reports original ablations, robustness experiments, or error analyses. The expanded research questions and methodological discussion are conceptual additions rather than supplementary experimental analyses.

E5.justification: Table 1 retains its mean and median conventions and the same estimation disclosure. No repeated-run information, confidence intervals, significance tests, or uncertainty-reporting procedures are added.

E6.justification: The numerical dataset summaries in Table 1 and model sizes in Table 5 are unchanged. Tables 2–4 retain their method entries; citation-year and venue updates do not change results. No new benchmark outcomes are reported.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(3) retain the same conditional formulations for future frames, multimodal information, and control signals. No mathematical assumptions, derivations, theorems, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The later abstract explicitly claims an explanation of architectural, dataset, and computational drivers and a concrete research agenda. The stochasticity-based taxonomy and two-direction outlook already existed in v6, so this is a limited refinement of the claimed analytical contribution.

C2.justification: Section 2.2 adds historical explanations involving computing resources and datasets. Section 8 expands the existing two-direction outlook into specific questions about hybrid architectures, motion distillation, tokenizers, and quantitative physical control, refining the survey's interpretation and applicability boundaries.

D1.justification: The dataset-estimation disclosure, model-size information, and descriptions of open-source availability are retained. No implementation, reproducibility procedure, or code/data access instructions for this work are added or revised.

R1.justification: v8 adds discussion or citations for works including V3D, Diffusion Forcing, ViStoryBench, and GPT-4o. Section 7 also makes distinctions from earlier prediction and diffusion surveys more explicit. Publication updates for retained works are bibliographic changes.

P1.justification: The abstract and conclusion are rewritten, the Transformer and motion-based subsections exchange order, and Section 4.2 gains numbered subheadings. Language, author information, and bibliography formatting receive additional edits, while the main organization and most prose remain intact.

P2.justification: v8 adds the taxonomy diagram as Figure 1. The existing dataset illustration becomes Figure 2 with a shorter caption; tables move with text reflow, and publication headers appear. All five existing tables are retained.

improvement.justification: The new taxonomy diagram improves navigation, and the expanded conclusion turns v6's broad directions into more concrete technical questions. Historical explanations and targeted literature additions make the survey more useful. These are limited gains in clarity and synthesis; the underlying taxonomy, dataset analysis, and formal content remain largely unchanged.
